name: Yusuf Arda Ilıca
headline: Junior producer and game designer, with an engineer's toolkit.
intro: I'm a computer engineering graduate now studying computer animation and game technologies at Hacettepe University. I led a team through a senior project, an LLM-driven NPC framework, and I'm producing Anima-1. I'm looking for a junior producer or game designer role where I can keep teams on schedule and make design decisions visible.

production: Plan in weekly milestones and report at monthly reviews, as I did leading a senior-project team.
Coordinate people and events: three years running an IEEE student branch, from coordinator to chair.
design: Design gameplay systems that pull against each other, as in the flashlight-and-sanity loop of Pan!c at the Server.
Write GDDs and narrative design a team can build from.
capabilities.technical: Unity (C#), Unreal (C++),Python and FastAPI, vector search and RAG; I also write test cases and playtest reports.

about: I’m a computer engineer who ended up drawn to the planning side of games: scoping the work, writing the design down, and keeping a team moving. I like long-form RPGs, and I can follow a backend design as well as a GDD, so I’m comfortable talking to programmers as well as designers

education.degree: MSc (non-thesis), Computer Animation and Game Technologies

seoDescription: Portfolio of Yusuf Arda Ilıca, a junior producer and game designer. Case studies, design documents and production plans from team game projects.
